topic.title: Winner deliverables when using permitted third-party pretrained weights
topic.content:
Could the organizers clarify how the training-code delivery requirement in section 2.8 applies to permitted, publicly available third-party pretrained weights used unchanged in a solution?

If the original training source for those third-party weights is not available in a complete, legally redistributable form, can winner delivery satisfy that requirement with the pinned weight sources, versions and licenses, the exact inference code and environment, and a reproducible description of their use? Or must complete, legally redistributable training source for those third-party weights also be provided?

This question concerns the scope of the winner-delivery requirement, not a request for an exception. We understand that permission to use external models does not by itself waive the other rules, and that licensing of pretrained inputs and delivery of reproducible code are separate obligations.
